evals.prompt: Add atuin to this dotfiles repo as a CLI app on macOS and Debian/Ubuntu, including its shell config. Keep it working on arm64 and amd64.
evals.expected_output: Adds one canonical CLI inventory entry with Brew mappings for both OSes, manages config through the CLI feature, and extends tests only for new behavior.
assertions: The package is added to .chezmoidata/packages.yaml rather than hardcoded in an installer.
Both darwin and linux Brew providers are represented.
Managed configuration is excluded when the CLI feature is disabled.

evals.prompt: Install Arc only on full macOS workstations. It should never appear on Linux, servers, containers, or the minimum GUI tier.
evals.expected_output: Adds a darwin-only gui-all cask and verifies its exclusions across other profiles and platforms.
assertions: The entry uses feature gui-all and provider cask.
The entry has an explicit darwin constraint.
No Linux package or special-case installer is added.
Matrix assertions cover workstation inclusion and other-profile exclusion.

evals.prompt: Add Caddy as a Debian/Ubuntu server service and manage its config, but don't start services inside containers.
evals.expected_output: Classifies Caddy as a Linux system service, uses apt metadata, scopes config and convergence to Linux servers, and excludes containers.
assertions: The package uses an apt provider and a linux constraint.
Service configuration uses resolved machine predicates.
Container profiles do not install or start the service.
A focused service lifecycle matrix test is added.

evals.prompt: Add a CLI formula from acme/tools called acme-lint for macOS and Linux. Homebrew says the tap must be trusted.
evals.expected_output: Adds a fully qualified third-party Brew formula with formula-level trust metadata and relies on the generic trust renderer.
assertions: The formula is owner/tap/formula qualified for both operating systems.
The entry declares tap acme/tools and trust formula.
No handwritten brew tap, trust, or install command is introduced.
Rendered Brew output trusts the formula before Brewfile evaluation.
